notes.title: Update notes for June 18, 2025
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed racing wheels not working at the beginning of races when using analog inputs.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Control key couldn't be remapped.
[*] Fixed various Linux/Steam Deck crashes.
[/list]If you have further controller issues, please report them in this topic:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2990/discussions/0/838346115741922384/

notes.title: Controller and crash fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed some racing wheels not working.[/*][*]Added support for unrecognized controllers.[/*][/list]Note: Wheels and unrecognized controllers will need to be manually configured in the options menu.

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where players could not see other players' multiplayer lobbies.[/*][*]Fixed crash when using mods that use an ASI Loader.[/*][*]Fixed all controllers breaking when 3 or more controllers are plugged in.
[list][*]Note: Due to engine limitations, the game only uses the first 2 controllers.[/list]
[/list]Note: If a controller isn't working as intended, re-insert the controller and restart the game.

If you are still having issues with controllers, please post them in this topic:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2990/discussions/0/838346115741922384/

notes.title: Improved controller support, better widescreen, and bug fixes!
notes.content: [h1]Changelog[/h1][list][*][p]Improved controller support.[/p][list][*][p]Added native support for Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo controllers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed analog controls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fully rebindable controller buttons.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved widescreen support.[/p][list][*][p]Improved FOV implementation. The FOV can now be configured by editing zoom_fo2.cfg.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed all menus, in-game UI, and graphics for 16:9, 16:10, and 21:9.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed extreme camera zoom out when boosting.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed workshop mods not applying on Linux/Steam Deck.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crashes on Windows 11.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Modding notes:[/h3][list][*][p]All .bed files located in the data/menu and data/scripts are now loaded per aspect ratio.[/p][list][*][p]16:9, 21:9 and 16:10 aspect ratios will use files in data/scripts/{aspect_ratio}, data/scripts/{aspect_ratio}, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]The supported aspect ratio folders are 16_9 for 16:9, 21_9 for 21:9 and 16_10 for 16:10.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]A selection of TGA files are now loaded per aspect ratio.[/p][list][*][p]16:9, 21:9 and 16:10 aspect ratios will use the data/menu/filename_{aspect_ratio}.tga files.[/p][/*][*][p]The supported aspect ratio postfixes are _169 for 16:9, _219 for 21:9 and _1610 for 16:10.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Jul 24
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed game launching in the background for some users.
[*]Fixed languages not working if the Steam client didn't match the chosen language.
    Language selection on Steam is now done via the game properties.
[/list]
[b][url=https://help.steampowered.com/faqs/view/4984-C127-121D-B3F2]Changing Language[/url][/b]
[olist]
[*]Right click the game title and select [b]Properties...[/b]
[*]Go to the [b]Language[/b] tab.
[*]Select the language you wish to use from the drop-down menu.
[/olist]

notes.title: Steam Deck ✅, Workshop 🔧 and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952774/7327b7158bfe59f4b47e8ca642979c33e194f900.png[/img]
It’s been 18 years since FlatOut 2 came crashing into your life. All FlatOut games have been updated with Steam Workshop, community items and more!

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/6220/view/4370264265339697534]FlatOut[/url] | [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/12360/view/4346620367298119035]FlatOut: Ultimate Carnage[/url][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Steam Deck Verified! ✅[/b]
[*][b]Added Steam Workshop! 🔧[/b]
[*][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/2990]Added Steam trading cards, backgrounds, emojis, and badges![/url][/b] ːfo2poseː
[*]Added Czech, Russian, Hungarian and Polish languages.
[*]Added Steam Cloud support.
[*]Added Steam rich presence.
[*]Restored unused track: "Papa Roach - Blood Brothers"
[*]Improved model pop-in.
[*]Improved FOV set by the game.
[*]Improved aspect ratio for widescreen monitors.
[*]Increased Lua memory limit.
[*]Increased buffer size.
[*]Enabled multiplayer hosted by OpenSpy.net
[/list]
Special thanks to the passionate [b]FlatOut modding community[/b]!
